authentication: The publisher documents an unauthenticated retail-price API.
attribution: Preserve Microsoft source, currency, region, SKU, unit, effective date, meter and price type.
retention: Retain time-bound source-stated offer observations and proof; never present them as executable quotes.
personal_data_treatment: Commercial catalog metadata only; reject unexpected customer or account data.
license_notes: Review Microsoft terms before retrieval; non-USD values are documented as reference estimates and must remain labeled.
emergency_disable: No network work order or price scheduler exists; future jobs stop on schema, terms or rate-policy change.
initial_scope: Proposed selected compute, storage and networking service families with explicit units and regions.
